financial_kpis.verdict: Investment Rejection Advised: Critical Section 188 promoter conflict and structural phantom revenue.

red_flags.title: Undisclosed Section 188 Promoter Self-Dealing & Siphoning
red_flags.description: Direct RTGS debit of ₹4,130,000.00 disbursed to Apex Cloud Solutions LLP. Slicing characters 3-12 of GSTIN '29ABCPS1234F1Z5' reveals PAN 'ABCPS1234F', which matches company Director Vikram Malhotra. Zero Board Resolution (Form MGT-14) or Audit Committee pre-approval on record.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Companies Act 2013 Section 188 (Related Party Transactions) & Section 185 (Prohibition of Loans to Directors)

red_flags.title: Fictitious / Phantom Revenue Invoicing Without Cleared Bank Cash (PHAN-INV-2026-001)
red_flags.description: Invoice PHAN-INV-2026-001 for ₹1,800,847.46 (+ ₹324,152.54 GST) was booked in CA sales and uploaded to GSTR-1, but marked 'UNOFF_SET_UNPAID' on GSTR-3B. Zero customer remittances entered the sovereign bank ledger across 180 days, inflating reported ARR by 57.8%.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Central Goods & Services Tax (CGST) Act 2017 Rule 88C (Tax Discrepancy) & ICAI SA 240 / SA 505 (Auditor Confirmation of Debtors)

red_flags.title: Month-End Cutoff Window Dressing & Contra Capital Infusion
red_flags.description: Temporary capital infusion of ₹2,500,000.00 injected into bank account on Day 28 of reporting month (2026-09-28) to artificially inflate closing cash balance, and drained out 4 days later on Day 2 of the subsequent month.
red_flags.statutory_citation: ICAI SA 240 (Material Misstatement Resulting from Fraud & Cutoff Manipulation) & Companies Act 2013 Section 129

red_flags.title: Section 194C / 194J Mandatory TDS Threshold Smurfing
red_flags.description: 25 repetitive disbursements of exactly ₹49,500.00 executed on the same day (totaling ₹12,37,500.00) to TechCloud Advisory LLP. Structured deliberately ₹500 below the statutory ₹50,000 threshold to evade mandatory 10% TDS deduction under Income Tax Act Section 194C/J.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Income Tax Act 1961 Section 194C, Section 194J & Section 271C (100% Penalty for Willful Tax Deduction Failure)

red_flags.title: Aged Trade Receivables > 180 Days (Uncollected Debtor Stagnation)
red_flags.description: CA General Ledger reflects ₹12,100,000.00 in receivables aged over 180 days with zero recovery in the bank ledger. DSO stands stretched at 146.1 days, indicating uncollectible customer revenue.
red_flags.statutory_citation: Companies Act 2013 Schedule III (Trade Receivables Aging Disclosures) & ICAI SA 505 (External Confirmations)
